body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings of claims in the application.

br.br:
1-23. (Canceled)222
24. (Currently Amended) An aircraft passenger seat unit comprising:a seat;
a privacy shell at least partially surrounding the seat, the privacy shell having a primary opening to allow entry to and exit from the seat unit;
a storage unit comprising one or more holders for supporting clothes stored in the storage unit, a back side located against an interior face of the privacy shell, and a front side;and
a door, movable in relation to the storage unit between a first position in which the door at least partially blocks off the primary opening, and a second position in which the door at least partially closes access to holders of the storage unit, wherein the front side of the storage unit provides access from the aircraft passenger seat unit to the holders of the storage unit.
25. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein the door in the first position fully blocks off the primary opening.
26. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein the door comprises a movable or removable portion, and wherein moving or removal of the portion provides a user with a secondary opening to allow an emergency exit from the seat unit when the door is in the first position.
27. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 26, wherein the removable portion is frangible, such that the removable portion can be broken from the rest of the door to provide the secondary opening.
28. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein the storage unit is fixed in relation to the privacy shell.
29. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein the holders of the storage unit are located at least 20cm above a floor of the aircraft passenger seat unit.
30. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein the storage unit is a wardrobe.
31. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein the one or more holders of the storage unit comprise a number of a hooks, shelves, and/or rails.
32. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein the door is arranged to slide between the first position and the second position.
33. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein a back side of the storage unit is located against the interior face of the privacy shell and wherein a front side of the storage unit provides access to the holders of the storage unit when the door is in the second position.
34. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 33, wherein a depth of the storage unit between the front side and the back side is deeper at a first end of the storage unit than at a second end of the storage unit.
35. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 34, wherein the first end of the storage unit is distal from the primary opening and the second end of the storage unit is proximate the opening.
36. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein the door is arranged to move between the first position and the second position in a direction offset from an angle of the interior face of the privacy shell.
37. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 24, wherein the privacy shell extends to a height of at least 100cm above a floor of the aircraft passenger seat unit.
38. (Previously Presented) An aircraft passenger seat unit comprising:a seat;
a privacy shell at least partially surrounding the seat, the privacy shell having a primary opening defining a first and second edge to allow entry to and exit from the seat unit; and
a door, movable between a first position in which the door at least partially blocks off the primary opening, and a second position, in which the door provides at least partial access to the primary opening, wherein the door is arranged to move between the first and second positions in a direction offset by an angle from the first edge of the primary opening of the privacy shell,
wherein the first edge is adjacent to the door when the door is in the second position, and wherein the door is arranged to slide between the first position and the second position in a direction along a length of the door.
39. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 38, wherein the movement direction of the door is offset from the first edge of the primary opening of the privacy shell by an angle between 1° and 30°.
40. (Previously Presented) The aircraft passenger seat unit according to claim 38, the door is located further away from a side of the seat unit providing the opening when in the first position than it is when in the second position.
41. (Cancelled)
